spec.expr:
quantile_over_time(
  0.50,
  {job="nginx_logs", service_name="nginx_logs", filename="/var/log/nginx/access.log"}
  | pattern `<ip> - - [<timestamp>] "<method> <uri> <protocol>" <status> <size> "<referer>" "<agent>" "<extra>"<request_time>`
  | unwrap request_time
  | __error__=""
  [1m]
) by ()
